name: Worn Saddlebag
description: A worn saddlebag of frayed canvas and cracked leather, patched and practical from years on the road.

name: Leather Saddlepack
description: A sturdy leather saddlepack with clean stitching, rolled flaps, and dependable adventurer utility.

name: Trail Saddlepack
description: A trail saddlepack of weathered hide and rope ties, compact and ready for mountain paths and far horizons.

name: Reinforced Saddlepack
description: A reinforced saddlepack of layered leather, silver buckles, and rugged corners built for heavy loads.

name: Expedition Saddlepack
description: An expedition saddlepack of durable canvas, gold-toned hardware, and neatly arranged travel compartments.

name: Grand Caravan Saddlepack
description: A grand caravan saddlepack of ornate leather, star-metal clasps, and spacious panniers fit for a merchant prince.

name: Rope Halter
description: A rugged rope halter of braided hemp and rawhide knots, sun-faded and trail-worn, with a frontier charm.

name: Leather Bridle
description: A supple leather bridle, oiled dark brown and stitched with neat artisan seams, fitted with plain brass buckles.

name: Studded Bridle
description: A tough studded bridle of reinforced leather, dotted with iron studs and carved rivets, built for hard riding.

name: Silvered Bridle
description: A polished silvered bridle shimmering with moonlit highlights, delicate filigree clasps, and elegant courtly finish.

name: Warbridle
description: A gold-fitted warbridle of blackened leather and heavy chain links, bristling with spiked fittings and battlefield strength.

name: Radiant Bridle
description: A star-metal radiant bridle with luminous runes, celestial enamel, and a regal halo-like gleam.

name: Pine Cart
description: A rugged pine cart with pale grain, copper-plated corners and copper-rimmed wheels. Loaded from camp or home.

name: Oak Cart
description: A heavy cart of dark oak with bronze-banded edges and robust bronze wheels. Loaded from camp or home.

name: Ash Cart
description: A slender pale ash cart with steel brackets and solid iron wheels. Loaded from camp or home.

name: Cedar Cart
description: A fragrant red cedar cart with silver-capped joints and polished silver wheels. Loaded from camp or home.

name: Ebony Cart
description: A sleek ebony cart with gold-trimmed panels and bright gold wheels. Loaded from camp or home.

name: Worldroot Cart
description: An ancient worldroot cart entwined with glowing star metal veins and arcane runes. Loaded from camp or home.

name: Rope Saddle
description: A hardy rope saddle of braided cord and rawhide lashings, simple, lightweight, and made for long trail rides.

name: Leather Saddle
description: A classic leather saddle with burnished panels, stitched edging, and a practical, time-tested riding form.

name: Cavalry Saddle
description: A disciplined cavalry saddle of reinforced hide and metal fittings, broad-seated and ready for swift mounted charges.

name: Silver Saddle
description: A graceful silver saddle with gleaming trim, moonlit clasps, and ornate embossed patterns of noble craft.

name: Champion's Saddle
description: A gilded champion's saddle of gold-inlaid leather and banner-stitched armor panels, fit for a victorious knight.

name: Starweave Saddle
description: A shimmering starweave saddle of star-metal thread, astral leather, and faint constellations stitched into the seat.

name: Leather Barding
description: Practical leather barding of layered hides and sturdy straps, weatherproof and dependable for everyday travel.

name: Studded Barding
description: Heavy studded barding of thick leather plates, iron bosses, and reinforced seams for added defense.

name: Hardened Barding
description: Hardened barding of boiled leather and metal bracing, dark and formidable with a battle-ready silhouette.

name: Scale Barding
description: A silver scale barding of overlapping metal plates, flexibly linked and catching the light like a fish's armor.

name: Dragonhide Barding
description: A gilded dragonhide barding with ember-toned scales, embossed ridges, and draconic grandeur.

name: Celestial Hide Barding
description: A star-metal celestial hide barding of pearlescent leather and glowing thread, softly radiant with heavenly sigils.

name: Copper Barding
description: Copper barding with warm reddish sheen, hammered plates, and aged patina glowing like sunset metal.

name: Bronze Barding
description: Bronze barding of noble antiquity, broad embossed plates and verdigris accents evoking ancient empires.

name: Iron Barding
description: Iron barding of dark forged plates, blunt, practical, and rugged with a stoic battlefield presence.

name: Silver Barding
description: Silver barding with mirror-bright segments, elegant edges, and a cool luminous finish worthy of nobility.

name: Gold Barding
description: Gold barding richly gilded and opulent, engraved with lavish scrollwork and royal heraldic details.

name: Star Metal Barding
description: Star metal barding of midnight alloy and twinkling inlays, as if forged from fallen constellations.

name: Riding Dog
description: A loyal riding dog with copper fur, sturdy build, and a practical saddle-backed trotting pace.

name: Horse
description: A plain horse with bronze-brown coat, weathered tack, and a calm road-worn expression.

name: Warhorse
description: A muscular warhorse with dark iron sheen, armored chest, and a bold battlefield snort.

name: Centaur
description: A silver-glimmering centaur with noble posture, flowing hair, and a half-human form carved from legend.

name: Unicorn
description: A golden unicorn with a radiant horn, pearl-white coat, and a gentle halo of sanctified light.

name: Pegasus
description: A star-metal pegasus with translucent wings, moonlit hooves, and a celestial wind-riding grace.

name: Boar
description: A squat wild boar with bristled copper fur, tusks like worn iron, and a stubborn woodland charge.

name: Dire Wolf
description: A lean dire wolf with bronze-tinted fur, amber eyes, and a hunter's prowling grace over stone and snow.

name: Mammoth
description: A young mammoth with gray hide, metal-capped tusks, and a heavy, earthshaking tread.

name: Griffin
description: A gleaming silver griffin with eagle wings and lion form, its feathers and mane touched by starlight.

name: Roc
description: A regal roc with gold-plated plumage, vast woodlike talons, and wings that command the sky.

name: Dragon
description: A magnificent dragon of star metal scales, crystal horns, and a furnace-bright chest glowing with ancient magic.

name: Terror Bird
description: A swift terror bird with copper feathers, a dagger beak, and an unsettling sprint through the grasslands.

name: Giant Scorpion
description: A broad giant scorpion with bronze shell plates, a curved stinger, and a creeping desert-warrior stance.

name: Giant Spider
description: A hulking giant spider with iron-black legs, a glossy abdomen, and a silent web-weaving menace.

name: Manticore
description: A silver-maned manticore with glassy wings, leonine muscle, and a venomous tail poised like a spear.

name: Chimera
description: A gold-scaled chimera with a lion's pride, dragon's fire, and a goat's cunning nestled in one impossible body.

name: Hydra
description: A star-metal hydra with many serpentine necks, shimmering scales, and each head crowned in eerie celestial light.

name: Giant Turtle
description: A sturdy young giant turtle with a mossy copper shell, muddy feet, and a slow, dependable river-hauling presence.

name: Hippocampus
description: A small hippocampus with bronze scales, a sleek fish tail, and a gentle tide-swaying gait fit for shallow waters.

name: Giant Shark
description: A compact giant shark with iron-gray hide, blunt fins, and a hard-edged predator's silhouette beneath the waves.

name: Kraken
description: A young kraken with dark sea-slick tentacles, barnacled limbs, and a deep-ocean menace still growing into its legend.

name: Sea Serpent
description: A silver-scaled sea serpent with luminous glassy fins and a sinuous body like a ribbon of moonlit surf.

name: Leviathan
description: A colossal leviathan of star metal scales and gilded ridges, vast as a floating island and radiant with abyssal power.
